no_git_installed: git executable not detected: file history relies on git. Install git and add it to PATH to enable this option.
no_git_repo: The project directory is not a git repository: file history relies on the git object store. Run git init in the project directory to enable this option.
desc_default_off: Off by default: no git commit is made in the project repository unless you explicitly enable it here.
desc_checkpoint: Before each tool call a checkpoint is taken (a snapshot of the current project directory) so changes can be reviewed along the timeline.
desc_perf: Large projects may be affected in performance, so enable with caution (off by default).
desc_retention: Retention: checkpoints are pruned when either the count exceeds "Keep count" or the oldest checkpoint is older than "Keep days"; the day window is anchored at the latest checkpoint time (idle projects won't drop old history).
desc_no_commit: No commits to your git branch: checkpoints do not create branch commits (the old "auto commit" semantics are deprecated), and the history chain is independent of your branch.
enable_confirm: When enabled, a checkpoint is taken on the current project directory before each tool call; large projects may be affected in performance. Enable anyway?
retention_hint: Checkpoints are pruned when either limit is exceeded (default 500 / 7); the day window is anchored at the latest checkpoint time.
empty_disabled: File history is not enabled (no checkpoint data).
clear_confirm: Clear all checkpoint history for this project? This cannot be undone.
